name: botte-secrete
description: Connect Codex to an independently installed Botte Secrète local runtime for context, routing and evidence workflows.

interface.shortDescription: Context and routing workflows with a local Botte runtime
interface.longDescription: A Codex workflow skill and stdio MCP connection to Botte Secrète. Install the compatible Botte runtime separately and make its botte-mcp executable available on PATH. The plugin does not bundle Python implementations, model weights or credentials.
